Launched 2006-09-22
NORAD ID 29484

Organization Hokkaido Institute of Technology

Headquarters Japan
Launch brokerer JAXA, ?
Oneliner

Demonstrate CubeSat platform technologies.
Description

Demonstrate the performance of the HIT-Sat bus system on orbit. HIT-Sat is an engineering test CubeSat, which is being used as a scale model for a future “Hokkaido microsatellite” .

Notes

Cube with side length of 12 cm.
